subject: jsont::base64_standard
prompt: With `rg --json`, a matching line that is not valid UTF-8 is emitted base64-encoded. Trace the call path from grep_searcher's Core::sink_matched (crates/searcher/src/searcher/core.rs) to the function that base64-encodes the line bytes. List every function or method in ripgrep's own code on that call path, including both ends; skip serde and serde_json internals and the blanket Sink impls for &mut S and Box<S>, and list only functions on the path (not helpers that return before it). Name free functions as module::function using the file's module name (for example main::run), and methods as Type::method.
